“Every event is a revenue conversation. The room, the agenda, the follow-through, all of it is pipeline architecture in disguise.”

With 18+ years spanning Fortune 500 agencies, corporate B2B, sports organizations, nonprofits, and independent consulting, I bring cross-sector intelligence that most event marketers simply don't have. I've managed events in 3 countries, rationalized processes across 14 offices, and maintained performance through two corporate restructurings.

My specialty is event marketing for companies and associations that treat events as a serious business driver, not a line item to cut. I engineer programs with the same rigor a CFO applies to capital allocation: clear objectives, measurable outcomes, and systems that outlast any single hire.

The Challenge

B&R's calendar ran across five separate industry trade shows, each borrowing a slice of the sales and engineering team for a few days at a time. AutomationCON was the one event the company owned outright, a self-hosted conference built to align regional sales managers, train engineers on new hardware, and put partners and prospects in a room with real machines, all inside one four-day production. Three months out, a highway fire closed a major interstate between the Atlanta airport and Lake Lanier Islands. Rather than a last-minute scramble, ground transportation for 245 attendees was strategically re-routed well ahead of the show, with food and beverage service added to the vehicles for the longer ride.

How I Executed
  • Served as B&R Trade Show Specialist and led the weekly cross-functional planning meeting across six workstreams from February through show week
  • Sourced and contracted the event photographer/videographer, writing the shot-list brief across five program tracks and managing the vendor agreement and liability release
  • Owned the venue relationship with Lanier Lodge, including room block, registration cutoff, shuttle service, and room layouts for four simultaneous meeting spaces
  • When a highway fire closed a major interstate route three months out, replanned airport transportation around the longer drive well in advance, adding food and beverage service to the vehicles
  • Built the trade showcase's exhibitor setup, load-in, and load-out schedule, coordinating freight and rigging for live hardware demos including an ABB YUMI robot
  • Maintained the working budget and partnered with accounting to reconcile invoices as costs shifted
  • Ran registration through Cvent and led the migration plan to CrowdCompass for the attendee mobile app
